protocol: Leave one existing training source out; fit vocabulary and classifier from scratch on other training sources. Fixed prior hyperparameters.
metric_policy: Macro F1 always uses all seven labels, including classes absent from an individual evaluation source. Pooled metrics weight rows, not sources.

checks: All 598 training rows evaluated exactly once; no val/test rows included
Nine saved models reproduce all internal predictions
Vocabulary terms and IDF values agree with fit rows only in every fold
Every source disjoint between fitting and evaluation
Per-source metrics and fold-specific majority baseline independently recalculated
Frozen evaluation hash unchanged; changes to holdout content do not alter internal folds
Baseline predictions and metrics verified before reuse
Same nine partitions and classifier settings; only analyzer and ngram range differ
Paired prediction changes and metric deltas reconciled
rejected_cases: Word mode rejects character comparison baseline

interpretation.conclusion: Modest pooled improvement with tradeoffs across sources and classes. Character variant is eligible for the next validation check, not production promotion.
interpretation.candidate_selection_basis: One planned representation comparison on the same internal source folds; pooled seven-class F1 macro increases. No new classifier tuning.

limits: Nine source groups; unequal group sizes and some very small groups. Pooled metrics weight rows.
Internal train-source comparison uses already reviewed data and previously selected C=4; not fresh external evaluation or final test.
Character features do not fix historical labels or prove that OCR noise caused errors.
Campaigns, leadership and republican organization F1 decrease while four other classes improve.
No statistical significance established; 48 newly correct and 38 newly incorrect examples.
Only analyzer/feature lengths changed: word unigrams+bigrams vs char_wb3-5. Other vectorizer settings and classifier parameters identical.
No new val/test predictions, BETO training, remote computation or production changes.
prediction_text_hash_encoding: The text_sha256 in predictions.json is fingerprint(text): SHA-256 of the canonical JSON string, not raw UTF-8 text.
next_step: Fit the preselected character variant on all 598 train rows and evaluate once on the original 81 validation rows, comparing with the recorded word model; do not predict test or deploy.
